instruction: Change the default search engine in Chrome to Bing.

parameters.command: echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt update -y && echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt install jq -y
cd /home/user/.config/google-chrome/Default && jq '. + {"session":{"restore_on_startup":4, "startup_urls":["http://funbrain.com/"]}}' Preferences > temp && mv temp Preferences

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent navigated to Chrome Settings > On start-up, found funbrain.com configured as startup page, clicked context menu > Remove, resulting in 'Open the New Tab page' being selected. Evaluator returned 0 despite UI showing correct state.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open Chrome three-dot menu, navigate to Settings, find specific settings sections, interact with dropdowns and UI controls
metadata.failure_analysis: Model appeared to complete the original task but evaluator returned 0.0. Model demonstrated strong Chrome settings navigation capability.
metadata.task_rationale: Leverages model's demonstrated ability to navigate Chrome settings. Search engine setting is in the same settings page, requiring similar navigation skills but a different section.
metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to Chrome Settings > Search engine and changing default search engine to Bing. Evaluator uses official default_search_engine getter with custom metric for case-insensitive string comparison.

scoring_breakdown.search_engine: 1.0 - Default search engine changed to Bing

llm_judge_reasons: Getter 'default_search_engine' correctly reads Chrome Preferences file and extracts 'default_search_provider_data.template_url_data.short_name', which is the correct field for the default search engine name.
Metric correctly handles expected parameter as the rules dict directly, accessing expected.get('expected_engine') without incorrectly wrapping in expected.get('rules').
Case-insensitive string comparison is appropriate for matching search engine names (e.g., 'Bing' vs 'bing').
Expected value 'Bing' is semantically correct for the instruction 'Change the default search engine in Chrome to Bing'.
Single-step instruction is fully covered by a single getter+metric pair — complete verification coverage.
Postconfig sleep(2) is sufficient since the getter reads the Preferences file directly (no UI state dependency).
